brief.aim: Predict the progesterone-receptor (PR) status of breast tumours in CPTAC-BRCA from mass-spectrometry protein abundance. Compare several classifiers with cross-validation on the training rows, and report discrimination, calibration and decision-curve analysis for the selected model.
brief.repeated_subjects: One row per tumour sample; no subject identifier repeats across rows.
brief.unit: one breast tumour sample (mass-spectrometry proteome profile)
